[[File:JunkGolem.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A junk golem on the planet Raxus Prime.]]
The '''junk golems''', also referred to as '''technobeasts''',<ref name="SWG-TFU">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20080222.html|text=Play ''The Force Unleashed'' Characters on your Tabletop}}</ref> were [[Monster droid/Legends|junk droids]] used by [[Kazdan Paratus]]. [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] was the only thing keeping them together. Paratus put these amalgamations of junk together to protect the Temple he created on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], especially from the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] scavengers. Different types of junk golems created by Paratus included [[Scrap Guardian]]s, [[Scrap Scavenger]]s, [[Scrap drone]]s, [[Junk behemoth]]s, and the [[Junk Titan]]. When Paratus was killed by [[Galen Marek]], the droids fell apart, leaving the planet defenseless to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
An article on [[StarWars.com]] once referred to the "Junk Golem" figurine from [[The Force Unleashed (Star Wars Miniatures)|''The Force Unleashed'']] [[Star Wars Miniatures|miniatures]] set as a "technobeast".<ref name="SWG-TFU" />
